description.value: Pentâge Winery is a family-owned estate on 23 acres overlooking Skaha Lake, producing small-batch, handcrafted wines from their Skaha Bench vineyards since their inaugural 1999 vintage. The property features a striking 5,000-square-foot natural rock wine cellar hand-built by founder Paul Gardner, and a tasting room with panoramic views of the lake and surrounding vineyards. It sits just outside Penticton on Valleyview Road, making it a natural waypoint on the South Okanagan wine route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates OSM contact details (address, phone, website). No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms anywhere on the site. A Tesla EV charger is noted on the contact and login pages but is explicitly restricted to wine shop customers and is vehicle-scale, not e-bike-relevant. OSM stores the name without the accent ('Pentage') while the website consistently uses 'Pentâge' — flagged as a concern.
